transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… my wife wanted me to come in, mostly. She got really scared because I keep hearing this water running, like a faucet left on, and men whispering in the walls when nobody’s there. I’ve checked, you know, like with the pipes and the bathroom and everything—our hallway has this old baseboard, I always thought maybe something behind it was leaking—but there isn’t anything.

And sometimes I see this dark wet-looking patch spreading across the hallway floor, like water soaking through, but when I go over there it’s dry. I know that sounds… I don’t know. But that’s what’s been happening.
Have you noticed anything else unusual, like seeing things, hearing voices, or feeling sensations that others don’t seem to notice?

Yeah… I mean, that’s the thing my wife keeps bringing up. I hear water running, like a faucet’s on somewhere, and I’ll go check the bathroom, the kitchen, even the walls because this house—well, the hallway has always had that weird baseboard, and I told her years ago it was probably going to be trouble someday.

But there’s no water. And sometimes it’s not just that, it’s like men whispering inside the walls. I can’t make out all of it, but it’s there. And then I’ll see this dark wet-looking patch spreading on the hallway floor, like it’s soaking through, but when I touch it or check it, it’s dry. My wife doesn’t see it. That’s what scared her.

Have you ever felt like your thoughts are being controlled by something outside of yourself, or believed that something is happening that isn't actually real, even though others don't share that belief?

I don’t know about thoughts being controlled exactly… but I do know something’s wrong in that house. I know it sounds far-fetched, and my wife gives me that look when I say it, but I’m certain the mold and the wiring have poisoned everything I own. Clothes, papers, even the furniture—it all feels contaminated somehow.

And the neighbors… they watch. I can tell. Not directly, like they don’t stand there staring, but you know when curtains move or someone gets quiet when you walk outside? They’re waiting to see when I mess up again. I’ve lived in places before where people minded their own business more, but here it’s different. So no, I don’t know if that’s “not real,” but I know what I know.
Do you believe that certain people are specifically trying to harm you or that events happening around you have special meaning directed at you?

Yeah… yes, I do. I know it sounds far-fetched when I say it out loud, but I’m certain the mold and the wiring in that house have poisoned everything I own. Not just the walls—my clothes, papers, furniture… like it’s all been ruined somehow.

And the neighbors notice. They act like they’re not watching, but I can tell. Curtains move, people get quiet, little things like that. It’s like they’re waiting to see when I mess up again. I know people think I’m making connections where there aren’t any, but… it doesn’t feel that way to me.
